title: The 30-year Treasury yield just hit a 19-year high. Three things could drive it even higher
summary_full: The yield on the 30-year U.S. Treasury has surged to its highest level in 19 years, and some strategists see scope for the move to go further.
summary_public: The yield on the 30-year U.S. Treasury has surged to its highest level in 19 years, and some strategists see scope for the move to go further.
